basis: Renal, cerebellar and thyroid disease define syndrome; thrombocytopenia 30-79%. Hearing loss (30-79%) omitted by four-axis cap.
Congenital cleft of lip, alveolar ridge and palate; dental abnormalities are oral. Recurrent otitis is separately diagnosed; hearing impairment is under 30%.
Tumour originates in the ovary, outside the axes; resemblance to renal Wilms tumour does not establish kidney involvement.
Clonal bone marrow disease with excess myeloblasts and ineffective blood cell production; other organ damage is not common.
Chronic allergic, immune-mediated eosinophilic inflammation of the oesophagus.
Disordered bone mineral metabolism and remodelling define the disease. Chronic kidney disease is the underlying separately diagnosed cause.
Congenital autoimmune diabetes defines endocrine pancreatic dysfunction with an autoimmune mechanism; no additional organ evidence supplied.
Psychiatric eating-disorder umbrella; no single pattern of direct organ damage applies to most patients across its subtypes.
Fragile, sparse hair and photosensitive skin with nonprogressive intellectual disability define the syndrome; no demonstrated metabolic disorder.
Wilms tumour originating in the kidney; absence of anaplasia does not change its organ of origin.
Leptin deficiency causes severe obesity and endocrine dysfunction; impaired T-cell activation and reduced CD4 cells occur in 80-99%, supporting intrinsic immune deficiency.
Skeletal dysplasia; respiratory insufficiency 8/8, renal phosphate wasting 5/6 and hypophosphatemia 5/6 support additional axes. Proptosis alone is not ocular damage.
Pathologic blood coagulation produces thrombi within vessels or heart chambers; downstream organ injury varies by thrombosis site.
Inherited cleft lip and palate affect oral structures; the TP63 association alone does not establish other organ involvement.
Shigella infection directly inflames and damages intestinal mucosa. Dehydration and electrolyte changes are acute consequences; extraintestinal organ damage is rare.
Sarcoma originates in uterine endometrial stroma, a reproductive tissue outside the axes.
Inherited central movement disorder with dystonia in 19/19; abnormal muscle contractions do not establish primary skeletal muscle damage.
Calculus within the kidney or urinary collecting system; a systemic metabolic disorder is not required across the umbrella.
Cerebellar degeneration and peripheral axonal neuropathy occur in 2/2. Muscle wasting is neurogenic; no independent muscle disease or direct gastrointestinal damage established.
Hereditary recurrent pregnancy loss is an obstetric and reproductive condition outside the axes; no immune or coagulation mechanism is established.
Neurodevelopmental impairment and brain abnormalities define the disorder alongside ocular defects, including optic atrophy and retinal dystrophy.
The supplied definition specifies neutrophilic dermatosis, an immune-mediated inflammatory skin disease; associated systemic illnesses are separate conditions.
Congenital unilateral absence of the foot is a structural limb and skeletal malformation.
Defined by chronic functional bowel dysfunction; no additional direct organ damage or immune-mediated disease is established.
Hereditary transthyretin protein misfolding causes predominant myocardial amyloid infiltration. Neuropathy and tendon complications are below 30% in supplied annotations.
